opencode_cli.notes: Shells out to `opencode run --standalone --format json` from a CLEAN cwd (no AGENTS.md, no skills) with PWD set to that cwd. --standalone is required because the shared background service owns its project config. PWD is required because subprocess(cwd=...) does not update it and OpenCode uses PWD for config discovery. Missing either surfaces as `Agent not found: "plain"`. `#high` is the active reasoning-effort variant: enough for the evidence layer without draining the free bucket or risking the 180s timeout. `#max` is for hard one-off analysis; `#low` is for bulk/simple calls. Without the clean cwd the agent loads skills and enters tool loops, burning quota -- observed as 90s timeouts then FreeUsageLimitError. Clean cwd measured at 17s for an 8-question batch.

opencode_http.notes: Free gateway, no login required. Direct HTTP from a non-OpenCode client is not a supported path for free-tier chat models (Console docs: 'Free-tier chat models require OpenCode'). Expect 429 FreeUsageLimitError; the CLI is the supported path. Kept as an adapter for paid models or when a key is added.

local_offline.notes: llama.cpp server (Termux, no root, no internet). Phone has ~3GB free RAM -> 3B params max at Q4. Set 'active' to this to go fully offline. Quality is LOWER than the free gateway.

paid_api.notes: Fill in base_url + model when you subscribe. 'auth' reads the named env var. Nothing else in the codebase changes.
